label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a _____ of water, whose waters fail not.
verse: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
note: The promise for true fasting — a soul like a watered garden and a spring that never runs dry.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou hast made known to me the ways of _____; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
verse: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
note: Peter quotes Psalm 16 at Pentecost: God makes known the ways of life and fills us with joy in His presence.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Zadok the priest took an _____ of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
verse: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
note: Zadok anointed Solomon from a horn of oil, the trumpet blew, and the people shouted, 'God save king Solomon.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: So they read in the book in the law of God _____, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
verse: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
note: Ezra's public reading came with explanation so the people understood — and they listened from morning until midday.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The _____ head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
verse: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
note: 'The hoary head is a crown of glory' — grey hair as a medal, if it's earned on the road of righteousness.
